wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 12-008 adds the long-run replay drift checks the final acceptance gate runs over the long attract loop, recorded demos, and the scripted E1M1 path. Because the step's write lock is src/oracles/ (not src/vanilla/), the aggregator is a NEW same-directory module src/oracles/longRunDriftChecks.ts re-exporting the two read-only oracle drift contracts: ./framebufferHash.ts (pixel drift: FRAMEBUFFER_WIDTH 320, FRAMEBUFFER_HEIGHT 200, FRAMEBUFFER_SIZE 64000, PALETTE_COUNT 14, DEFAULT_FRAMEBUFFER_SAMPLING_INTERVAL_TICS 35, FramebufferHashEntry/Payload/Artifact, and the frozen EMPTY_TITLE_LOOP / EMPTY_DEMO_PLAYBACK framebuffer baselines) and ./stateHash.ts (tic/state drift: STATE_HASH_COMPONENTS 6, DEFAULT_SAMPLING_INTERVAL_TICS 35, INDIVIDUAL_COMPONENT_COUNT 5, StateHashComponent/Entry/Payload/Artifact, and the frozen EMPTY_TITLE_LOOP / EMPTY_DEMO_PLAYBACK state baselines), values via export and types via export type under verbatimModuleSyntax (neither source declares a const enum). VANILLA_LONG_RUN_DRIFT_CHECK_INVARIANTS pins five rules: the combined state hash is SHA-256 over the five individual components in ASCIIbetical order; the demo-playback pixel+state baselines are frozen empty payloads; both drift checks sample every 35 tics; the framebuffer is 320x200 across 14 palettes; and the title-loop pixel+state baselines are frozen empty payloads. The focused test is inventory-neutral: constants, the frozen five-rule manifest, the frozen re-exported baselines, the leading-JSDoc-stripped ./-filtered specifier set ['./framebufferHash.ts','./stateHash.ts'], and dynamic same-reference identity against both read-only oracle modules. An all-inventory probe confirmed zero drift in every plan_vanilla_parity inventory (the oracle infra modules are not inventory-tracked). The step became eligible with prerequisites 12-006, 04-007, 06-009, and 11-008 COMPLETED; a transient concurrent progress-log claim on 12-008 was released before this work began (verified: no live progress log or status JSON, frontier probe clean).
